name: Big 2 × Dodgeball Dojo®
detailed_description:
Classic family card game played by millions worldwide, now animated with modern manga in Dodgeball Dojo®!

Features:

Big 2 / Pusoy Dos - Easy and fun card shedding game inspiration

Play Together - Real time competition against players globally with poker rules

Dodgeball - Animations connect winning card hands with control strategy and speed energy

Athlete Ability - Throw wild gameplay twists by forming Bombs with card combos

Pet Power - Discover unique emperor advantages activated by Spirit Pet elements

Private Party - Host tournaments and play with family and friends on your own rules

Emote - Level up to collect dances and emojis to troll your friends in real time

Martial Arts - Discover choreography and cultures around the world, from kung fu to jiu jitsu

Spirit Pets - Get lucky and win animals from around the world

Anime - Blends art styles of Japanese manga with Americana comic strips

World Tour - Unlock your favorite Stadium and get home court advantage

Events - Exciting challenges give free rewards

Win Big - Climb leaderboards and score rewards

Big 2, known by many names worldwide, is an East meets West universally beloved family game. Referred to as 大老二/斗地主 in China , 锄大弟 in Hong Kong, Pusoy Dos in Philippines, Daifugō(大富豪) in Japan, Tiến Lên in Vietnam, Capsa in Indonesia, and President in Europe.

Follow us @DodgeballDojo on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, and YouTube!

PLEASE NOTE! Dodgeball Dojo® is free to download and play, but some game items can be purchased with real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

A persistent network connection is also required to play (network fees may apply).

Last but not least, thank you to our family and friends who supported us as we worked those long hours.
